hero.title: AI phone answering for tradespeople: never miss a job
hero.subtitle: You know the feeling: you're in the middle of a job and the phone rings. If you answer it, you lose focus. If you don't, you risk losing a good job. It's an impossible situation.

solution.title: Never miss a job again
solution.description: Our AI receptionist solves this problem once and for all. The system answers every call, records customer details, books site visits and sends the customer a confirmation by email. In your dashboard you can see every enquiry, listen to recorded conversations, get short summaries of what the customer wants, and see what's been agreed. The booking goes straight into your Google, Outlook or Cal.com calendar. Stop worrying about missed jobs – focus on your craft.
